title: CIA chief in Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
english: The director of the CIA has made an unannounced visit to Moscow, arriving on a US military aircraft. While both the American and Russian governments have kept the details of the visit private, such high-level meetings are unusual given the ongoing tensions between the two nations. This trip marks a significant diplomatic moment, as it is one of the first visits by a top US official to Russia during President Trump's second term.
amharic: የሲአይኤ (CIA) ዳይሬክተር በድንገት ወደ ሞስኮ በዩኤስ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። የአሜሪካ እና የሩሲያ መንግስታት ስለ ጉብኝቱ ዝርዝር መረጃ ባይሰጡም፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ምክንያት እንዲህ ያሉ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያላቸው ስብሰባዎች ያልተለመዱ ናቸው። ይህ ጉብኝት በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን በከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን ወደ ሩሲያ ከተደረጉ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ጉዞዎች አንዱ በመሆኑ ትልቅ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Hoogganaan garee iccitii Amerikaa (CIA) xiyyara waraanaan gara Moskooti imala tasaa ta'e godhaniiru. Mootummoonni Amerikaas ta'e Raashiyaa waa'ee imala kanaa ilaalchisee ibsa kennuu baatanis, hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii waan jabaateef walgahii sadarkaa olaanaatti gaggeeffamuun kun kan barame miti. Imalli kun yeroo pirezidaant Traamp erga aangoo qabatanii booda hoogganaa olaanaa Amerikaa irraa gara Raashiyaatti imalame keessaa tokko waan ta'eef, iddoo guddaa qaba.

title: Nevada wildfire contained to 27 percent as thousands still displaced
english: A major wildfire near Reno, Nevada, has reached 27 percent containment after destroying dozens of homes and forcing thousands of people to evacuate. Although the fire has stopped spreading, seven people have been injured and officials expect the damage toll to increase as they inspect the area. This is the third fire in the region in two weeks, and schools remain closed as authorities continue to monitor for shifting winds.
amharic: በኔቫዳ ሬኖ አቅራቢያ የተነሳው መጠነ ሰፊ የእሳት ቃጠሎ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን ካወደመ እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ካፈናቀለ በኋላ በ27 በመቶ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የእሳቱ መስፋፋት የቆመ ቢሆንም፣ ሰባት ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ሲመረምሩ የደረሰው ጉዳት ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ስጋት አድሮባቸዋል። በሁለት ሳምንት ውስጥ በክልሉ የተከሰተ ሶስተኛው የእሳት አደጋ ይህ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የአየር ሁኔታን እየተከታተሉ በመሆኑ ትምህርት ቤቶች ዝግ ሆነው ይቆያሉ።
oromo: Ibidda cimaa magaalaa Reno, Nevada biratti ka'een erga manni hedduun barbada'ee fi namoonni kumaatamaan buqqa'anii booda, amma %27 to'annoo jala galeera. ibidichi babalachuu dhaabatus, namoota torba irratti miidhaan ga'eera; akkasumas bakkeewwan gubatan qorachaa waan jiraniif miidhaan inni geesise dabaluu mala jedhamee amanama. Ibidni kun torban lama keessatti naannichatti yeroo sadaffaaf ka'uudha; haala qilleensaa fi qilleensa bubbee hordofuuf jecha mana barumsaatu cufamee jira.

title: Chinese robot Tiangong clocks sub-9-second 100 metres in Beijing
english: A Chinese humanoid robot named Tiangong recently completed a 100-meter sprint in 8.86 seconds during the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. This performance is notably faster than the long-standing human world record held by Usain Bolt. The event, which features thousands of robots competing in various activities, highlights the rapid technological advancements in robotics.
amharic: ቲያንጎንግ የተሰኘ የቻይና የሰው ቅርጽ ያለው ሮቦት በቤጂንግ በተካሄደው የአለም የሮቦቶች ውድድር የ100 ሜትር ሩጫን በ8.86 ሰከንድ በማጠናቀቅ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ውጤት ዩሴን ቦልት ካስመዘገበው የሰው ልጅ የአለም ክብረ ወሰን በአጅጉ ፈጣን ነው። በቤጂንግ እየተካሄደ ያለው ይህ ውድድር በሮቦቲክስ ቴክኖሎጂ የታየውን አስደናቂ እድገት ያሳያል።
oromo: Roobotiin bifa namaa qabu Tiangong jedhamu tokko, Beijingitti dorgommii roobotaa adunyaa irratti meetira 100 sekondii 8.86 keessatti xumuruun riikardii haaraa galmeesseera. Gatiin kun riikardii atileetii Yuseen Boolt qabu kan caaluudha. Dorgommiin Beijingitti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun, teeknooloojii roobotaa guddina guddaa agarsiisaa jira.

title: Infantino’s presidency under threat: FIFA elections, challengers, dates
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing significant challenges to his leadership as his support among national football federations declines. Critics are particularly concerned about his close ties to US political figures and his controversial proposal to privatize World Cup profits. With elections approaching in six months, his decade-long tenure is under threat due to growing international backlash.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በአገር አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽኖች ዘንድ ያላቸው ድጋፍ እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ የአመራር ሥልጣናቸው አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። ተቺዎች በተለይም ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ጋር ያላቸው የቅርብ ግንኙነት እና የዓለም ዋንጫ ትርፍን ወደ ግል ለማዞር ያቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። በስድስት ወራት ውስጥ ምርጫው የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ በአሥር ዓመታት ውስጥ ባካበቱት ተጽዕኖ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaannii Infantinoo deeggarsa federeshiniiwwan kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa biratti dhabuun hoggansi isaa balaa keessa galeera. Qeeqonni keessattuu hariiroo inni angawoota siyaasaa Yunaayitid Isteetsii wajjin qabu fi karoora inni bu'aa Waldaa Kubbaa Miilaa Addunyaa (World Cup) gara dhuunfaatti jijjiiruuf qabu irratti komii guddaa qabu. Ji'oota jahan dhufan keessatti filannoon waan jiruuf, qeeqni idil-addunyaa irratti xiyyeeffate kun waggaa kudhan booda aangoo isaa jalaa raasaa jira.

title: Nine years of Rohingya refugee crisis
english: It has been nine years since a violent military crackdown in Myanmar forced the Rohingya people to flee their homes for safety. Many sought refuge in Bangladesh, where over 1.2 million individuals continue to reside in camps today. The United Nations has previously described the military actions against this community as having genocidal intent.
amharic: የሮሂንጋ ሕዝብ ከማያንማር ወደ ባንግላዴሽ ከተሰደደ ዘጠኝ ዓመታት ተቆጥረዋል። በወቅቱ በወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተፈናቀሉት ከ1.2 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች አሁንም በስደተኛ ካምፖች ውስጥ በችግር ላይ ይገኛሉ። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በሮሂንጋዎች ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ዘር የማጥፋት ዓላማ የነበረው መሆኑን አስታውቆ ነበር።
oromo: Sabni Roohingiyaa lola fi dararaa biyya Maaniyaamar irraa baqatee gara Baangilaadesh erga seenee waggaan sagal darbeera. Namoonni miiliyoona 1.2 ol ta'an amma iyyuu baqattummaan buufataalee garaagaraa keessa jiraachaa jiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii tarkaanfiin waraanni biyyattii isaan irratti fudhate kaayyoo sanyii duguuggaa kan qabu ture jechuun gabaaseera.

title: Gaza marks one year since Mariam Dagga was killed in Israeli strike
english: Mourners in Khan Younis recently gathered to commemorate the first anniversary of an Israeli airstrike that killed 22 people at a Gaza hospital. Among those who lost their lives in the attack were journalist Mariam Dagga and several emergency responders. Despite the significant loss of life, no officials have faced accountability for this incident.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ የሚገኙ የሟች ቤተሰቦች እና ወዳጆች በጋዛ ሆስፒታል ላይ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የጋዜጠኛ ማርያም ዳጋን ጨምሮ 22 ሰዎች ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት መሙላቱን አስታውሰዋል። በጥቃቱ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችም ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። እስካሁን ድረስ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ የሆነ አካል አለመኖሩም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Namoonni gaddan Khan Yunisitti walga’uun, waraana Israa’el hospitaala Gaazaatti gaggeesseen gaazexeessituu Maariyaam Daaggaa dabalatee namoonni 22 erga ajjeefamanii waggaa tokko guutuu isaa yaadataniiru. Ajjeechaa kanaan gargaartonnii fi ogeessonni fayyaa lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Ajjeechaa kanaaf hanga ammaatti qaamni itti gaafatamummaa fudhate hin jiru.

title: Child injured by Israeli forces' gunfire in Qalandia refugee camp
english: A Palestinian child was shot and injured in the shoulder by Israeli soldiers during an operation in the Qalandia refugee camp near Jerusalem. This event occurred as tensions rise in the area due to Israeli forces taking control of a local vocational training center. The situation follows an escalation in military presence and activities within the camp.
amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው በቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች በከፈቱት ተኩስ አንድ የፍልስጤም ህጻን ትከሻው ላይ ቆስሏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች በካምፑ ውስጥ የሚገኝ የሙያ ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከልን በኃይል መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ በተፈጠረው ግጭት ነው። በካምፑ ውስጥ ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ መጨመር በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan Yerusaalemitti argamu keessatti, waraanni Israa'el dhukaasa bananiin mucaan tokko kan gubbee irraa miidhamee jira. Miidhaan kun kan uumame yeroo waraanni Israa'el buufata sana keessatti iddoo leenjii hojii harka qaban tokko humnaan to'annaa isaanii jala galchanidha. Haalli kun walitti bu'iinsa fi lola naannichatti dabalaa deemu keessatti kan uumame dha.

title: War on Iran: Left-wing luminaries behind Guardian letter have lost the plot
english: A group of prominent activists recently published a letter in The Guardian that equates the Iranian government's human rights abuses with the aggressive military actions taken against Iran by Israel and the US. The author criticizes these intellectuals for adopting a 'both-sides' perspective, arguing that their stance ignores the reality of the destructive aerial bombings and the anti-colonial sentiment rising within Iran. Ultimately, the piece suggests that this call for intervention fails to support actual Iranian political prisoners who have publicly condemned the foreign military attacks.
amharic: የአንድ ቡድን ታዋቂ አክቲቪስቶች በጋርዲያን ጋዜጣ ላይ ባወጡት ደብዳቤ የኢራን መንግሥት በሰብአዊ መብት ላይ የሚፈጽመውን ጥሰት በእስራኤል እና በአሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ እየተወሰዱ ካሉ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ጋር አነጻጽረዋል። የጽሁፉ ደራሲ እነዚህ ምሁራን ሁለቱንም ወገን ተጠያቂ የሚያደርግ አቋም በመውሰዳቸው ይተቸዋል፤ ይህ አካሄድ በኢራን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የቦምብ ጥቃት እና በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ እየተቀጣጠለ ያለውን ፀረ-ቅኝ ግዛት ስሜት ችላ የሚል ነው ይላል። በመጨረሻም፣ ይህ የጣልቃ ገብነት ጥሪ በውጭ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ላይ በይፋ የተቃውሞ ድምጻቸውን ላሰሙ የኢራን ፖለቲካ እስረኞች ትክክለኛ ድጋፍ እንደማይሰጥ ይከራከራል።
oromo: Gareen aktivistoota beekamoo ta'an tokko barreeffama 'The Guardian' irratti baasaniin, mootummaan Iran mirga namoomaa darbuu isaa fi gocha waraanaa Israa'el fi Ameerikaan Iran irratti raawwachaa jiran wal-qixxeessanii ilaalu. Barreessaan kun yaada kana ni balaaleffata; kunis tarkaanfiiwwan xiyyaaraan darbaa jiruufi miira qabsoo gita-bittaa mormuu Iran keessatti mul'achaa jiru kan dagatanii dha. Walumaagalatti, yaanni gargaarsa biyya alaa gaafatu kun, miidhaa waraanaa kana ofii isaanii kan morman hidhamtoota siyaasaa Iran irratti xiyyeeffannoo akka hin kennine ibsa.

title: Israeli forces to remain in Syria-Lebanon border area, says defence minister
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz announced that military forces will maintain a presence in the Mount Hermon region near the Syrian-Lebanese border. He stated that this strategic position is necessary to monitor threats from Damascus and Hezbollah while protecting local communities in the Golan Heights and Galilee. The minister emphasized that this ongoing occupation serves as a direct message to the Syrian leadership regarding Israel's commitment to border security.

title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
english: Two individuals in Pennsylvania have passed away from measles, highlighting a concerning rise in cases across the United States. Health officials noted that the vaccination rate in the affected area is too low to prevent community spread. Experts emphasize that the MMR vaccine remains the most effective way to protect against this dangerous and increasingly common illness.

Ogeeyyiin fayyaa dhukkuba cimaa kana ittisuuf talaallii MMR fudhachuun furmaata guddaa akka ta'e gorsu.

title: One year since Gaza journalist killed by Israel
english: It has been one year since AP journalist Mariam Dagga lost her life during an Israeli military strike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital. Her family continues to seek accountability and justice for her death. This tragedy highlights the ongoing dangers faced by media professionals working in the conflict zone.

oromo: Gaazexeessituun dhaabbata oduu AP, Mariyam Daaggaa, hospitaala Naasir kan Gaazaa keessatti miidhaa qaqqabeen du’uu ishee waggaa tokko guuteera. Maatiin ishee du’a ishee ilaalchisee ammayyuu haqni akka bahuuf gaafachaa jiru. Balaan kun gaazexeessitoota naannoo waraanaa keessa hojjetan balaa hamaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: No, the Democratic Party is not shifting on Israel
english: Despite recent primary victories by progressive candidates critical of Israel, the Democratic Party establishment remains fundamentally supportive of the Israeli government. While public polling shows a significant decline in sympathy for Israel among Democratic voters, party leadership is merely adjusting its rhetoric to manage political pressure. These shifts in language are strategic election-year maneuvers rather than a genuine change in long-standing institutional policy.

title: Root ‘hacked off’ by England cricket team after police handcuff Carse
english: England Test captain Joe Root has expressed his deep frustration after bowler Brydon Carse was dropped from the team for being handcuffed by police following a nightclub incident. This event is the latest in a series of alcohol-related controversies involving England players that have distracted from the team's performance on the field. Root criticized his teammates for repeatedly making foolish errors and emphasized the need to build a more professional team culture instead of relying on restrictive curfews.

Kuni rakkoo dhugaatii fi amalaan walqabatee taphatoota Ingiliz irraa yeroo dhihoo as deddeebi'ee mul'achaa jiru keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, gama taphaan argamaa jiru irratti dhiibbaa gaarii hin taane uumaa jira. title: Trump floats renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America during Canada trade war
english: President Donald Trump has suggested renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America as tensions rise during a trade dispute with Canada. This proposal follows the U.S. government's decision to impose 50 percent tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods. Canadian officials have stated they will not engage with these comments and are preparing to implement their own retaliatory measures.

title: China says will safeguard its own interests as US expands Iran sanctions
english: China has firmly rejected new US sanctions against Iran, vowing to protect its own economic interests and legal rights. Beijing maintains that its trade relationship with Tehran, particularly regarding oil imports, is legitimate and should not be disrupted by unilateral measures. While the US continues to threaten penalties against entities dealing with Iran, experts suggest that diplomatic complexities may prevent the US from taking direct action against Chinese banks.

title: China warns US of retaliation over expansion of Iran sanctions
english: China has cautioned the United States that it will take retaliatory actions if Washington applies secondary sanctions against Chinese firms involved in trade with Iran. This warning follows recent US efforts to further isolate Tehran, which included penalizing several Chinese entities linked to Iranian oil activities. Beijing remains strongly opposed to these unilateral measures and has urged both nations to prioritize diplomatic negotiations over economic confrontation.

Chaayinaan tarkaanfiiwwan akkasii kanneen qofaatti fudhataman kan mormitu ta'uu ibsuun, biyyoonni kunneen rakkoo isaanii mariin akka furatan gaafatteetti.

title: Israeli lawmaker smashes Palestinian memorial in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli lawmaker Zvi Sukkot used a sledgehammer to destroy a Palestinian memorial in the West Bank village of Madama. He claimed the monument honored individuals who had killed Israelis and argued that its presence encouraged violence among local youth. Although he was escorted by the military, the army stated that the destruction was unauthorized and took steps to stop the act.

Yaadannichi namoota Israa'eloota ajjeesan kan yaadatu ta'uu fi dargaggoota naannichaa gara hammeenyaatti kan kakaasu ta'uu isaatiin kaasuun isaa himameera. Waraana Israa'el waliin kan deeman ta'us, waraanni biyyattii garuu diigamuu yaadannichaa kanaaf hayyama hin kennineef turre jechuun tarkaanfichaa dhaabsisaniiru.

title: Trump says US removed all mines from Strait of Hormuz
english: President Trump announced that all explosives have been cleared from the Strait of Hormuz. He warned Iran that the United States will strictly punish any future attempts to plant mines in the area. This new zero-tolerance policy aims to ensure safe navigation through these important international waters.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ የነበሩ ፈንጂዎች በሙሉ መጽዳታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን ወደፊት በአካባቢው ፈንጂ የመትከል ሙከራ ብታደርግ አሜሪካ ጥብቅ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ አዲሱ ፖሊሲ በአለም አቀፍ የውሃ መስመሮች ላይ የመርከቦችን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Tiraamp bishaan Hormuz keessaa minoonni ykn meeshaleen waraanaa hundi kaafamuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Iran gara fuulduraatti naannicha keessatti minii kamiyyuu akka hin dhaabneef Ameerikaan tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhattu akeekkachiisaniiru. Dambiiwwan haaraan kun bishaan idil-addunyaa kana keessatti nageenya dooniiwwanii eeguuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: China warns US of retaliation over expansion of Iran sanctions
english: China has cautioned the United States against imposing new sanctions on Chinese firms linked to trade with Iran, threatening to retaliate if such measures are taken. This warning follows a recent US move to target various entities for their involvement with Tehran, creating potential conflict between the two global powers. Beijing firmly rejects these unilateral penalties and has the legal capacity to strike back, particularly by restricting critical mineral exports essential to American industries.
amharic: ቻይና ከአሜሪካ ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት ባላቸው የቻይና ኩባንያዎች ላይ አሜሪካ ማዕቀብ የምትጥል ከሆነ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቃለች። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው ዋሽንግተን ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት ባላቸው አካላት ላይ ማዕቀብ መጣሏን ተከትሎ ነው። ቤጂንግ እነዚህን የአሜሪካ የአንድ ወገን እርምጃዎች አጥብቃ የምትቃወም ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካ ለቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፏ የምትጠቀምባቸውን ወሳኝ ማዕድናት ወደ ውጭ የምትልክበትን መንገድ በመዝጋት አጸፋ መመለስ እንደምትችል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Chaayinaan, yoo Ameerikaan dhaabbilee Chaayinaa kanneen Iraan wajjin daldalan irratti tarkaanfii fudhatte, ofishee tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga waashingtaniin qaamolee daldala Iraan wajjin qaban irratti qondaaltota Ameerikaatiin kanaan dura tarkaanfiin fudhatamee booda. Chaayinaan tarkaanfiiwwan Ameerikaan kophaa ishee fudhattu kana kan mormitu yoo ta'u, gama birootiin meeshaalee biyya alaa keessatti barbaachisoo ta'an kan akka 'critical minerals' dhiyeessuu dhaabuun Ameerikaa miidhuuf humni akka ishee harkaa jiru beeksiseetti.

title: Israeli lawmaker smashes Palestinian memorial in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli lawmaker Zvi Sukkot destroyed a Palestinian memorial in the West Bank village of Madama using a sledgehammer. He claimed the site encouraged violence, though the Israeli military stated the action was unauthorized and criticized the lawmaker for his deceptive behavior. Local village officials disputed the military's account, noting that soldiers were present and did not intervene as the monument was damaged.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፓርላማ አባል ዝቪ ሱኮት በማዳማ መንደር የሚገኝ የፍልስጤማውያን መታሰቢያ ሐውልትን በመዶሻ ሰባብረዋል። ተወካዩ ሐውልቱ ለጥቃት ያነሳሳል በሚል ሰበብ እርምጃውን የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ግን ድርጊቱ ህገ-ወጥ እና ተገቢ ያልሆነ ነው ሲል ገልጿል። የአካባቢው መንደር አስተዳዳሪዎች በበኩላቸው ወታደሮቹ በቦታው ቢገኙም ሐውልቱ ሲፈርስ ምንም አይነት ጣልቃ ገብነት አላደረጉም ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል።
oromo: Miseensi Mana Maree Israa'el Zvii Sukuut jedhaman, yaadannoo ganda Maadaamaa keessatti argamu tokko humnaan diiganiiru. Sukuut yaadannoon kun waraanaaf kakaasa jechuun kan diigan ta'us, waraanni Israa'el tarkaanfichi seeraan ala fi karaa itti yaadamee kan hin hayyamamne ta'uu beeksiseera. Haa ta'u malee, qondaallonni gandichaa akka ibsanitti, loltoonni Israa'el bakka sana kan turan ta'us diigicha dhaabuuf wanti godhan hin jiru.

title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
english: A recent study suggests that chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a degenerative brain condition caused by repeated head trauma, is significantly more common in deceased NFL players than previously estimated. Research indicates that up to 97.7% of players examined may have suffered from this disease, which is often linked to the cumulative impact of hits sustained throughout their entire athletic careers, including high school and college. Experts are now calling for better safety measures at all levels of football to help minimize the risk of brain injury.
amharic: አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በተደጋጋሚ የራስ ጉዳት የሚመጣው ሲቲኢ (CTE) የተባለ የአንጎል በሽታ የቀድሞ የኤንኤፍኤል (NFL) ተጫዋቾች ላይ ከዚህ ቀደም ከታሰበው በላይ በስፋት ይገኛል። ጥናቱ እንደሚያመለክተው እስከ 97.7 በመቶ የሚደርሱ ተጫዋቾች በህይወት ዘመናቸው ባሳለፉት የትምህርት ቤት እና የኮሌጅ ጨዋታዎች በደረሰባቸው ተደጋጋሚ ተጽዕኖ ለዚህ በሽታ ተጋልጠዋል። ባለሙያዎች የራስ ጉዳትን ለመቀነስ እና ተጫዋቾችን ለመጠበቅ በሁሉም የጨዋታ ደረጃዎች ላይ ጥብቅ የደህንነት እርምጃዎች እንዲወሰዱ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan tokko akka agarsiisutti, dhukkubni sammuu 'CTE' jedhamu kan gadoo fi rukuttaa mataa irraa dhufu, taphattoota NFL darban gidduutti tilmaama kanaan dura ture irra baay'ee ol aanaa dha. Qorannoon kun akka ibsutti, hamma dhibbeentaa 97.7 kan ta'an taphattootaa dhukkuba kanaan qabamuu danda'u; kunis taphoota sadarkaa mana barumsaa fi kolleejjii irraa jalqabee rukuttaa mataa irra ga'uun kan walitti kuufame dha. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa tapha kubbaa miilaa sadarkaa hunda irratti miidhaa mataa hir'isuuf tarkaanfiin eegumsaa cimaan fudhatamuu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Trump’s latest wave of Iran sanctions: Which 60 entities are targeted?
english: The United States has imposed new sanctions on nearly 60 entities and individuals across the globe to increase economic pressure on Iran during the ongoing conflict. These measures specifically target networks involved in Iran's oil trade, weapons procurement, and cyber operations, aiming to cut off the country's economic lifelines. While U.S. officials described this as an effort to isolate Iran, Iranian officials have dismissed the sanctions, stating that they have strategies in place to overcome them.
amharic: ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ለመጨመር በዓለም ዙሪያ በሚገኙ ወደ 60 የሚጠጉ ድርጅቶች እና ግለሰቦች ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በተለይም የኢራንን የነዳጅ ንግድ፣ የጦር መሳሪያ ግዥ እና የሳይበር እንቅስቃሴዎችን በማነጣጠር የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ መስመሮች ለመዝጋት ያለሙ ናቸው። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህን እርምጃ ኢራንን ለመነጠል የተወሰደ ሲሉ የገለጹት ቢሆንም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ማዕቀቡን ውድቅ በማድረግ ችግሩን ለመቋቋም ዝግጅት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitii Itoophiyaa waliin walitti dhufeenya qabanis ta'e guutummaa addunyaatti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee Iran irratti jirtu dabaluuf namoota fi dhaabbilee 60 ta'an irratti ergaa haaraa laatteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun gurgurtaa boba'aa, bitii meeshaa waraanaa fi hojii saayibarii Iran irratti xiyyeeffachuun, maddoota diinagdee ishee addaan kutuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Qondaaltonni Ameerikaa tarkaanfichi Iran addunyaa irraa fageessuuf kan gargaaru yoo jedhanis, qondaaltonni Iran garuu tarkaanfichaan waan tokkollee akka hin taane fi isaanis kana dandamachuuf tarsiimoo qaban dubbataniiru.

title: US military transport plane arrives in Moscow in rare occurrence
english: A United States military C-17 aircraft unexpectedly landed at an airport in Moscow after traveling from Latvia. While Russian officials stated they lacked information regarding the plane's purpose, a diplomatic group was observed leaving the site under police escort. This event is highly unusual given the current geopolitical tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የጭነት አውሮፕላን ከላትቪያ ተነስቶ በሞስኮ በሚገኝ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በድንገት አርፏል። የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ስለ አውሮፕላኑ መምጣት ምንም የሚያውቁት ነገር እንደሌለ ቢገልጹም፣ ዲፕሎማቲክ ተሽከርካሪዎች በፖሊስ ታጅበው ሲወጡ ታይተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ውስጥ እጅግ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ሆኗል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri fe’umsaa waraana Ameerikaa tokko kan Latviyaa irraa ka’e tasa buufata xiyyaaraa Moskoo gahuun isaa dinqisiiseera. Mootummaan Raashiyaa waa’ee xiyyaarichaa homaa akka hin beekne ibsatus, gareen diippilomaatotaa tokko poolisiin geggeeffamanii bakkachaa sanaa bahuun isaanii mul’ateera. Gochi kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii keessatti haalaan kan nama ajaa’ibuudha.

title: How can a heavily indebted football club afford Mo Salah?
english: Mohamed Salah has become the highest-paid football player in Turkey, despite the country's professional clubs collectively facing massive financial debts. This situation raises questions about how these teams manage to afford expensive international stars while struggling with significant economic instability. The report explores the financial mechanisms and strategies that allow Turkish clubs to sustain these high salary commitments.
amharic: መሐመድ ሳላህ በቱርክ እግር ኳስ ታሪክ ከፍተኛ ተከፋይ ተጫዋች ሆኗል። ይህ የሆነው የቱርክ ክለቦች በጋራ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ዕዳ ውስጥ እያሉ ነው። ክለቦቹ ከፍተኛ ዕዳ እያለባቸው እንዴት ለኮከብ ተጫዋቾች ደመወዝ መክፈል እንደሚችሉ እና ይህንን የገንዘብ አቅም እንዴት እንደሚመሩ ሪፖርቱ ያብራራል።
oromo: Mohamed Salah taphataa kubbaa miilaa Turkei keessatti mindaa olaanaa argatu ta'eera. Kun kan ta'e utuu kilaboonni biyyattii walii galaan liqii guddaa keessa jiranuudha. Gabaasni kun kilaboonni kun liqii guddaa akkasii keessa ta'anii akkamitti taphattoota gurgudduuf mindaa kafaluu akka danda'an fi akkamitti akka dinagdee isaanii hoogganan ibsa.

title: Trump plans largest mass visa cancellation in history: Who will it affect?
english: The Trump administration plans to cancel approximately 200,000 business and tourist visas held by individuals who have sought or are currently seeking asylum in the United States. This measure targets foreign nationals who allegedly entered the country for short-term visits but applied for permanent residency through asylum claims. The policy is part of a broader crackdown on immigration that includes stricter deportation efforts and new restrictions on birthright citizenship.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በአሜሪካ ጥገኝነት የጠየቁ ወይም በመጠየቅ ላይ ያሉ ወደ 200,000 የሚጠጉ የንግድ እና የቱሪስት ቪዛዎችን ለመሰረዝ አቅዷል። ይህ እርምጃ ለአጭር ጊዜ ጉብኝት ገብተው በኋላ ላይ በቋሚነት ለመኖር ጥገኝነት የጠየቁ የውጭ ዜጎችን ያነጣጠረ ነው። ይህ አዲሱ ፖሊሲ፣ መንግሥት በስደተኞች ላይ እየወሰደ ካለው የከረረ የኢሚግሬሽን ቁጥጥር እና የዜግነት መብት ገደብ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp namoota biyya Ameerikaa keessatti baqattummaa gaafatan ykn gaafachaa jiran irratti biizinasii fi turizimii dhaaf kennamee ture 200,000 ol ta'u akka haqamuuf karoorfataa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun namoota akka daawwattootaatti biyyattii seenanii booda bakka bu'uuf hayyama baqattummaa gaafatan irratti xiyyeeffata. Karoorri kun mootummaan imaammata godaantotaa irratti qabu kan jabeesse yoo ta'u, bu'uura seeraa lammummaa dhalootaan argamu irrattis dhiibbaa uumuu jalqabeera.

title: Real Madrid’s Mourinho ‘happy’ with transfers despite Rodri miss
english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho stated he is satisfied with his current roster following the summer transfer window, despite failing to sign Rodri, who ultimately joined rivals Barcelona. The club successfully brought in six new players, including Yan Diomande and Bernardo Silva, to reinforce the team after the departures of veterans Toni Kroos and Luka Modric. Although Mourinho considers his squad complete, he remains open to last-minute opportunities if players seek transfers.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አሰልጠና ጆሴ ሞሪንሆ፣ ሮድሪን ወደ ባርሴሎና ቢወስዱትም አሁን ባለው የቡድን ስብስብ ደስተኛ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ክለቡ ከቶኒ ክሮስ እና ከሉካ ሞድሪች መውጣት በኋላ በያን ዲዮማንዴ እና በበርናርዶ ሲልቫ የሚመሩ ስድስት አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን አስፈርሟል። አሰልጣኙ ቡድኑ እንደተጠናቀቀ ቢናገሩም፣ በገበያው የመጨረሻ ቀናት ሊያጋጥሙ የሚችሉ ያልተጠበቁ ዝውውሮች ቢኖሩ ክፍት መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Real Madrid Jose Mourinho, Rodri gara Barcelona deemus illee, garee amma qabanitti akka gamadan ibsaniiru. Kilabichi erga Toni Kroos fi Luka Modric deemanii booda, Yan Diomande fi Bernardo Silva dabalatee taphattoota haaraa ja'a walitti qabachuun garee isaanii cimseera. Mourinho gareen isaanii akka guutuu ta'e kan amanan ta'us, yoo carraan haaraan uumame gara fuulduraatti jijjiirama gochuuf fedhii qabu.

title: Sliman Mansour, a pioneer of contemporary Palestinian art, dies aged 79
english: Sliman Mansour, a renowned Palestinian artist, has passed away at the age of 79. Throughout his career, he used his paintings to preserve Palestinian history and identity by incorporating cultural symbols like olive trees and traditional embroidery. His work served as a powerful response to the loss of land and the erasure of the Palestinian narrative, leaving behind a profound legacy.
amharic: የዘመናዊ ፍልስጤም ጥበብ አቅኚ የሆኑት ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ። ማንሱር በሥራዎቻቸው የፍልስጤምን ታሪክ እና ማንነት ለመጠበቅ የወይራ ዛፎችን እና ባህላዊ ጥልፍ ስራዎችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ምልክቶችን ይጠቀሙ ነበር። የጥበብ ሥራዎቻቸው የፍልስጤም ህዝብ የደረሰባቸውን መፈናቀል እና ታሪካቸውን ለመቀየር የሚደረገውን ሙከራ በመቃወም ለትውልድ የሚሻገር ትልቅ ቅርስ ትተው አልፈዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun og-barruu fi fakkiiwwan ammayyaa kan Falasxiin Sliman Mansuur umuriisaanii waggaa 79tti du'aan boqotaniiru. Mansuur hojiiwwan isaanii keessatti mallattoowwan aadaa akka muka ejersaa fi uffata aadaa fayyadamuun seenaa fi eenyummaa Falasxiin eeguuf carraaqqii guddaa godhaniiru. Hojiin isaanii seenaa Falasxiin akka hin dagatamneef gumaacha guddaa kan godhe yoo ta'u, dhalootaaf seenaa guddaa of duubatti dhiisanii darbaniiru.

title: How Israel’s Netanyahu weaponises religion in his war rhetoric
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has increasingly used religious references and ancient texts to justify his military strategies and preemptive strikes. Critics argue that by framing the war in these terms, he is attempting to bypass international law and provide moral cover for actions in Gaza. This inflammatory rhetoric, which includes comparisons to biblical enemies, has faced significant legal scrutiny and accusations of inciting violence.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሀገራቸውን ወታደራዊ ስልቶች እና ቅድመ ጥቃቶች ትክክለኛነት ለማሳየት ሃይማኖታዊ ጥቅሶችን እና ጥንታዊ መጻሕፍትን መጠቀም አዘውትረዋል። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት፣ ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ ሕጎችን ለመሻገር እና በጋዛ ለሚፈጸሙ ድርጊቶች የሞራል ሽፋን ለመስጠት የታለመ ነው። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ አነቃቂ ንግግር፣ የመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ጠላቶችን ማስታወስን ጨምሮ፣ ከፍተኛ የሕግ ምርመራ እና ግጭትን በማባባስ ክስ አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benjaamin Netiyaahuu tarsiimoo waraanaa isaanii fi haleellaa dursanii fudhatamuuf bu'uura amantii fi barreeffamoota durii fayyadamuu baay'isaniiru. Gamtaan mormitootaa akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun seera idil-addunyaa darbuu fi gocha Gaazaa keessatti raawwatamuuf akka sababaatti fayyadamaa jiru. Dubbiin gubaa fi kanneen akka diinota Kitaaba Qulqulluu wajjin wal-bira qabuu, qorannoo seeraa cimaa fi waraana kakaasuun himatamaniiru.

title: Popcorn and cartoons: A Gaza cinema gives girls a brief escape from war
english: A charitable organization in Deir el-Balah is providing a weekly movie experience for displaced girls living in Gaza to help them cope with the ongoing war. Through simple screenings featuring popcorn and fake tickets, these young participants find a much-needed temporary escape from their difficult realities. This initiative offers a safe space for girls like 14-year-old Natalie to experience moments of joy and comfort amidst the trauma of displacement.
amharic: በዴይር ኤል-ባላህ የሚገኝ አንድ የበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት በጋዛ ለተፈናቀሉ ልጃገረዶች በየሳምንቱ የፊልም ፕሮግራም በማዘጋጀት የጦርነቱን ጭንቀት እንዲረሱ እየረዳቸው ነው። ተሳታፊዎቹ በፖፕኮርን እና በቲያትር ትኬቶች የታጀበውን ይህን መዝናኛ በመጠቀም፣ ከባድ ከሆነው የዕለት ተዕለት የጦርነት ሕይወት ለአፍታም ቢሆን እፎይታን ያገኛሉ። ይህ ፕሮግራም እንደ ናታሊ ላሉ ልጃገረዶች በተፈናቀሉበት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ደስታን እና መረጋጋትን የሚያገኙበት ብቸኛ ዕድል ሆኗል።
oromo: Jaarmayaan gargaarsa namoomaa tokko magaalatti Deeyr el-Balaah keessatti, ijoollee durbaa waraanaan buqqa'anii fi rakkina hamaa keessa jiranuf sagantaa fiilmii torban keessatti al tokko qopheessa. Ijoolleen kun kornii fi tikkeetiin fakkeeffamee qophaa'u kanaan, gaddaa fi soda waraana keessa jiran yeroo gabaabaafis ta'u dagachuuf carraa argatu. Sagantaan kun ijoollee akka Naataalii jiranuf rakkoo fi miira hir'inaa keessatti gammachuu fi tasgabbii argachuuf bakka itti fayyadamani dha.

title: Gaza child breaks down in tears after an Israeli threat over kites
english: A young child in Gaza was filmed crying as he destroyed his own toy kites. This heartbreaking action followed warnings from Israeli forces that they would launch airstrikes at the specific location where the kites were being flown. The incident highlights the intense fear and emotional toll experienced by children living in the conflict zone.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ ህጻን የራሱን መጫወቻ ዒላዎች ሲያፈርስ የሚያሳይ ምስል በካሜራ ተቀረጸ። ይህ የሆነው እስራኤል ዒላዎቹ በሚበሩበት አካባቢ የአየር ድብደባ እንደሚፈጽም ባስጠነቀቀችበት ወቅት ነው። ድርጊቱ በግጭቱ ቀጠና ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ህጻናት የሚደርስባቸውን ከፍተኛ ፍርሃትና የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ያሳያል።
oromo: Mucaan tokko Gaaza keessa jiraatu, xiyyaarota isaa kan tapha xiyyaaraa ofiinuu yommuu caccabsu suuraan isaa kaafameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe, waraanni Israa'el xiyyaarotni sun iddoo itti balaliifaman irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraan akka raawwatu akeekkachiisa erguu isaatiin booda dha. Mudannoon kun ijoollee naannoo waraanaa keessa jiran irratti sodaa fi miidhaan miiraa guddaan akka jiru mul'isa.

title: Two killed, refinery on fire in Russia’s Krasnodar after drone attack
english: A Ukrainian drone strike on Russia's Krasnodar region caused a major fire at the Afipsky oil refinery and resulted in two deaths at a nearby railway station. This attack is part of an ongoing Ukrainian strategy to target Russian energy infrastructure to weaken its economy and war efforts. In response, Russia has increased its own strikes on Ukrainian military supply routes while President Putin moves to tighten control over critical infrastructure protection.
amharic: በሩሲያ ክራስኖዳር ክልል በሚገኝ የአፊፕስኪ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ በዩክሬን የድሮን ጥቃት ደርሶ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፤ በደረሰው ጥቃትም በባቡር ጣቢያ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ኢኮኖሚና የጦር አቅም ለማዳከም የሃገሪቱን የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ጥቃት እየፈፀመች ነው። ለዚህ ምላሽ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የጦር መሳሪያ ማጓጓዣዎች ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘረች ሲሆን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲንም ወሳኝ መሰረተ ልማቶችን የመጠበቅ ስልጣኑን ወደ መንግስት እያዞሩ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Yukreen kutaa Krasnodar kan Raashiyaatti argamu irratti iddoo qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Afipsky irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen raawwateen ibiddayi ka'eera. Haleellaa kana hordofee buufata baaburaa naannichatti argamu irratti namootni lama du'aniiru. Yukreen sochiiwwan waraana Raashiyaa fi dinagdee ishee laaffisuuf xiyyeeffannoo ishee buufataalee boba'aa fi anniisaa irratti godhachaa jirti. Raashiyaan gama isheen haleellaa Yukreen irratti deebii kenniteefii jirtu yoo ta'u, Pireezidaanti Putiinis labsii dhaabbilee bu'uuraa biyyattii irratti to'annoo cimaa gochuu dandeessisu mallatteessaniiru.

title: ‘We can’t breathe’: Indonesians battle wildfire haze
english: Widespread wildfires are currently burning across ten provinces in Indonesia, creating a dangerous layer of thick smoke for local residents. Firefighters are working hard to extinguish the flames while citizens eagerly await rainfall to clear the air. Even local youth have stepped up to assist, with one teenager wearing a superhero costume to help with the relief efforts.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ በአስር አውራጃዎች ውስጥ የተነሱ ሰደድ እሳቶች ከፍተኛ የጢስ ብክለት በመፍጠራቸው የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ሕይወት አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎችም ዝናብ እንዲዘንብ በጉጉት እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ። ወጣቶችም ለዚህ ጥረት የበኩላቸውን ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ አንድ የ16 ዓመት ወጣት በልዩ አልባሳት ተውቦ በእሳት ማጥፊያ ስራው ላይ መሳተፉ ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Indoneziyaa keessatti bosonnii fi lafti gubachaa jiru kutaalee biyyattii kudhan keessatti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Aaraan cimaan uumamee jiru kunis namoota naannichaa irratti rakkina fayyaa uumaa jira. Biddibiddii kana dhaamsuuf hojjettoonni tasgabbii fi namoonni fedhii isaaniin hojjetan carraaqqii gochaa jiran yoo ta'u, uummannis rooba roobee aara kana dhaamsuf abdii godhachaa jiru.

title: Iranians queue for petrol after US announces new sanctions
english: Following the United States' announcement of new economic sanctions against Iran, long lines have appeared at gas stations in Tehran. U.S. officials intend to cut off Iran's economic resources, leading to widespread public anxiety regarding potential fuel shortages and rising costs. While the Iranian government claims to be accustomed to such pressure, citizens remain concerned about the impact of these measures on the country's stability.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአን ላይ አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መጣሏን ተከትሎ በቴህራን በሚገኙ የነዳጅ ማደያዎች ላይ ረጅም ወረፋዎች ታይተዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የአገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ አቅም ለማዳከም አቅደናል ቢሉም፣ ይህም በነዳጅ አቅርቦት እጥረት እና በዋጋ ንረት ላይ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል የሚል ስጋት በህዝቡ ዘንድ ፈጥሯል። የኢራን መንግስት ማዕቀቡን እንደማይበግረው ቢናገርም፣ ተራው ህዝብ ግን በኢኮኖሚው ላይ የሚኖረውን አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ በመፍራት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ameerikaan Iran irratti erga sanqii ykn qabxii diinagdee haaraa labsitee booda, magaalaa Teheran keessatti buufataalee boba'aa irratti hiriirri dheeraan uumameera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa dandeettii diinagdee Iran laaffisuuf karoora qabaachuu isaa erga ibsee booda, namoonni boba'aa dhabuu fi gatiin isaa dabaluu isaa ni sodaatu. Mootummaan Iran dhiibbaa kana akka hin sodaanne ibsuus, ummanni garuu tarkaanfichi diinagdee biyyattii irratti miidhaa geessisa jedhanii yaadu.

title: UK to back Ukraine with missile blueprints amid Russia-Ukraine strikes
english: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham recently traveled to Kyiv for his inaugural international visit to show support for the country. During this trip, Britain committed to providing Ukraine with technical blueprints for cruise missiles. This decision comes as both Russia and Ukraine continue to increase their use of long-range aerial attacks in the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ለዩክሬን ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለማሳየት የመጀመሪያ የውጭ ጉብኝታቸውን ወደ ኪየቭ አድርገዋል። በጉብኝታቸውም ወቅት፣ ብሪታንያ ለዩክሬን የክሩዝ ሚሳይል ዲዛይኖችን ለመስጠት ቃል ገብታለች። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በጦርነቱ ወቅት የረጅም ርቀት ጥቃቶችን እያጠናከሩ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa UK Andy Burnham deeggarsa isaanii ibsuuf gara Kiyiv imaluun daawwanna isaanii isa jalqabaa biyya alaa taasisaniiru. Daawwannaa kanaan, biyyi Britaniyaa damee meeshaa waraana gosa 'cruise missile' kan ta'e diizaayinii isaa Yukireeniif akka kennitu waadaa galteetti. Murtii kana kan taasisan, yeroo ammaa biyyootni kunneen lamaan duula waraana fagoo irratti xiyyeeffatuu isaaniti.

title: How water becomes a weapon of war
english: Water is increasingly being exploited as a tactical tool in modern conflicts, threatening the survival of vulnerable populations. By restricting access to clean water or damaging infrastructure, warring parties use basic human needs to exert control or pressure their adversaries. This manipulation of essential resources often leads to severe humanitarian crises and long-term environmental damage.
amharic: በዘመናዊ ጦርነቶች ውስጥ ውኃ እንደ ጦር መሣሪያ የመጠቀም አዝማሚያ እየጨመረ መጥቷል ይህም ለብዙዎች ሕልውና ከፍተኛ ሥጋት ሆኗል። ተፋላሚ ወገኖች ንጹሕ ውኃ እንዳይገኝ በማድረግ ወይም መሠረተ ልማቶችን በማውደም ሰዎችን ለማስገደድ ወይም ተጽዕኖ ለመፍጠር ይሞክራሉ። ይህ መሠረታዊ የተፈጥሮ ሀብትን የመቆጣጠር ተግባር ከፍተኛ ሰብአዊ ቀውሶችን እና ዘላቂ የአካባቢ መራቆትን ያስከትላል።
oromo: Waraana ammayyaa keessatti bishaan meeshaa waraanaatti fayyadamuun babal’achaa jiraachuun isaa jireenya namoota hedduuf balaa ta’eera. Gireen waraana keessatti argaman bishaan qulqulluun akka hin argamne gochuun ykn bu’uuraalee misoomaa diiguun, namoota irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaalu. Qabeenya bu’uuraa kan ta’e bishaan kana akka meeshaa waraanaatti itti fayyadamuun, rakkoo namoomaa cimaa fi miidhaa naannoo yeroo dheeraaf turu geessisa.

title: Rwanda accuses DR Congo of supporting an armed group on its soil
english: Rwandan President Paul Kagame has justified his country's military presence in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by citing the threat posed by the FDLR rebel group. Kigali claims that the Congolese government is actively arming and integrating these fighters into their own military, a move it views as a direct security risk. While Kinshasa denies these claims and accuses Rwanda of backing the M23 movement, President Kagame insists that Rwanda will keep intervening until the FDLR threat is fully eliminated.
amharic: የሩዋንዳው ፕሬዝዳንት ፖል ካጋሜ በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል የሀገራቸው ወታደሮች መገኘታቸውን በኤፍዲኤልአር (FDLR) አማፂ ቡድን ስጋት ምክንያት አረጋግጠዋል። የሩዋንዳ መንግስት የኮንጎ ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን አማፂያን በጦር መሳሪያ በመደገፍ ወደ ሰራዊታቸው እንደቀላቀሏቸው ይከሳል። በሌላ በኩል ኮንጎ ይህንን ክስ በመካድ ሩዋንዳ ኤም 23 የተባለውን አማፂ ቡድን እንደምትረዳ ትከሳለች፤ ሆኖም ካጋሜ የኤፍዲኤልአር ስጋት እስካልተወገደ ድረስ ሩዋንዳ ጣልቃ ገብነቷን እንደምትቀጥል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Ruwaandaa Pool Kaagaameen, waraanni Ruwaandaa naannoo bahaa Koongoo keessa akka jiru kan ibsan, garee finxaaleyyii FDLR irraa soda jiruun akka ta'e dubbatan. Mootummaan Ruwaandaa, mootummaan Koongoo garee kana meeshaan gargaaruu fi loltoota isaanii waliin walitti makuu isaa himata. Gamtaan, mootummaan Koongoo himata kana haaluun Ruwaandaan garee M23 deeggarti jechuun himatti, garuu Pireezidaantii Kaagaameen hanga balaan FDLR irraa jiru dhufu dhabamutti, Ruwaandaan dhimma kana keessa galuu ishee itti fufti jechuun ibsan.

title: Rohingya refugees demand justice, dignity at Cox’s Bazar protest
english: Tens of thousands of Rohingya refugees living in Bangladesh recently organized a massive protest to mark the ninth anniversary of their displacement from Myanmar. They are calling for international help to address severe food shortages and poor living conditions in the overcrowded Cox's Bazar camps. Protesters also demanded justice for past atrocities and emphasized their right to eventually return safely to their homeland.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በሚገኙ የሮሂንጃ ስደተኞች ካምፖች ውስጥ የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች፣ ከማያንማር የተፈናቀሉበት ዘጠነኛ ዓመት ለማሰብ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ስደተኞቹ በተጨናነቁት ካምፖች ውስጥ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የምግብ እጥረት እና የኑሮ ሁኔታ ለመቅረፍ አለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በደረሰባቸው በደል ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን እና ወደ አገራቸው በሰላም የመመለስ መብታቸው እንዲከበር አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Godina Cox's Bazar kan biyya Bangladeshi keessatti baqattoonni Roohingaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman, waggaa saglaffaa biyya isaanii Maayaanmar irraa baqatan yaadachuuf hiriira mormii guddaa gaggeessaniiru. Baqattoonni kunneen campiiwwan cinaan guutaman keessatti hanqina nyaataa fi rakkoo jireenyaa mudate furuuf deeggarsa idil-addunyaa gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, miidhaa dur isaan irra gaheef haqni akka argamuufi gara biyya isaaniitti nagaan deebi'uuf mirga qaban akka kabajamuuf sagalee dhageessisaniiru.

title: Russia mobilisation fears grow amid reports of intimidating tactics
english: Concerns are rising in Russia over increasingly aggressive and coercive recruitment tactics ahead of a potential winter offensive in Ukraine. Reports indicate that authorities are allegedly using force and intimidation, including physical threats and kidnapping-style roundups, to sign up men for military service. While government officials deny these claims, many citizens are living in fear and avoiding public spaces to escape being forcibly drafted.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የክረምት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ለማካሄድ በምትዘጋጅበት ወቅት በግዴታ ወታደራዊ ምልመላ ላይ እያሳየች ያለችው ጠንካራ እና አስፈራሪ አካሄድ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ባለስልጣናት ወንዶችን በኃይል ለመመልመል ጥፊ፣ ማስፈራራት እና አፈናን እንደ ስልት እየተጠቀሙ ነው የሚሉ ዘገባዎች እየወጡ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የሩሲያ መንግስት እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች ቢክድም፣ ብዙ ወጣቶች በኃይል ወደ ጦር ግንባር ከመላክ ለመዳን በመፍራት ቤታቸው ተወስነው ለመቀመጥ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan duula waggaa gannaa Yukreen irratti gaggeessuuf qophii gochaa jirtuun wal-qabatee, mala humnaan waraanaatti galchuu ishee irratti sodaafi mormiin guddaan ka’aa jira. Mootummaan dargaggoota humnaan waraanaaf akka mallatteessan dirqisiisuuf, doorsisaa fi bakka tokko tokkotti butii fayyadamaa jiraachuu gabaasni ni mul’isu. Mootummaan gabaasa kana kan haalu ta’us, dargaggoonni baay’een sababa soda kanaatiin bakka ummataa bahuu sodaachaa jiru.

title: Israeli settlers attack AFP journalists in occupied West Bank
english: A group of Israeli settlers assaulted AFP journalists and activists in the occupied West Bank near Bethlehem on Tuesday, resulting in five people needing medical attention. The attackers threw stones and struck a reporter with a stick after the military had ordered the news team to vacate the area. Additionally, the journalists discovered that their vehicles had been severely damaged, with broken windows and flattened tires.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በቤተልሔም አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የተያዘው ምዕራባዊ ዳርቻ ላይ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የኤኤፍፒ ጋዜጠኞችን እና አክቲቪስቶችን አጠቁ። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ አምስት ሰዎች ለህክምና እርዳታ መዳረጋቸውን የገለፁ ሲሆን፣ የዜና ቡድኑ አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ወታደራዊ ትእዛዝ ከተሰጠ በኋላ በድንጋይ መወርወር እና በዱላ ተደብድበዋል። በተጨማሪም የጋዜጠኞቹ ተሽከርካሪዎች መስታወታቸው ተሰብሮ ጎማቸው መበሳቱ ታውቋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe naannoo Beetalihem, qe'ee Falasxiin kan humnaan qabame keessatti, jiraattonni Israa'el garee gabaastota AFP fi duula gaggeessitoota irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni shan miidhamee hospitaala kan geessifaman yoo ta'u, haleeltotni sun dhagaa darbachuufi uleen reebichaa raawwataniiru. Kana malees, konkolaataawwan gabaastotaa haleellaa kanaan cabanii fi konkolaataan isaanii miidhaa cimaa irra ga'ee jira.

title: The Palestinian-American determined to defend his home from Israeli settlers
english: Louai Abu Ridi, a Palestinian-American living in Ohio, has been distressed after witnessing armed Israeli settlers harass his family and occupy his property in the West Bank through security cameras. The situation intensified when the group set up tents outside his home in an attempt to displace his relatives. Despite his efforts to seek help from local authorities and US officials, he remains deeply concerned about the safety of his ancestral house.
amharic: በኦሃዮ የሚኖረው ፍልስጤማዊው አሜሪካዊ ሉአይ አቡ ሪዲ፣ የታጠቁ የእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን የቤተሰቡን ቤት በካሜራ ሲቆጣጠሩና ሲያሸብሩ በመመልከቱ ከፍተኛ ጭንቀት ውስጥ ገብቷል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ቤተሰቡን ለማፈናቀል የቤቱ አጥር ግቢ ውስጥ ድንኳን በመትከል ተጽዕኖ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። አቡ ሪዲ የአካባቢውን ፖሊስና የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናትን ለእርዳታ ቢጠይቅም፣ የቤተሰቡ ደህንነት አሁንም አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Luu’aay Abuu Riidii kan jedhaman lammii Ameerikaa fi Falastiiniin Ohaayoo jiraatan, namoonni hidhatanii jiran kan Israa'el, mana isaanii kan Qusraa jiru to'achuufi maatii isaanii doorsisuu isaanii kaameeraan hordofaa turan. Gareen kun maatii isaa mana keessaa baasuuf jecha mooraa manaa keessatti dunkaana buusuun rakkoo guddaa uumaniiru. Innis poolisii fi qaamolee mootummaa Ameerikaa gaafatus, nageenyi maatii isaa ammayyuu balaa keessa jira.

title: Israeli forces raid Unrwa centres serving 16,000 Palestinian refugees
english: Israeli military forces have raided two vocational training centers operated by UNRWA in the West Bank, which provide essential services to roughly 16,000 Palestinian refugees. This action is part of a broader trend of hostility toward the UN agency, following previous attacks on their facilities in East Jerusalem. Political pressure from far-right Israeli officials to shut down the organization continues to grow ahead of upcoming elections.

Gochi kun miidhaa kanaan dura waajjira guddaa dhaabbatichaa kan Baha Yerusaalem keessatti raawwatamee wajjin wal qabata. Ministiroonni biyyattii warri mirga-jabeeyyii ta'an, filannoo dhufu dura dhaabbaticha guutummaatti diiguuf dhiibbaa cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: French far-right leader Marine Le Pen polling at record high ahead of 2027 election
english: A recent poll shows French far-right leader Marine Le Pen leading significantly ahead of the 2027 presidential election. Although she was previously convicted of financial misconduct, a court ruling has allowed her to remain eligible to run for office. Meanwhile, left-wing parties are struggling to unify as they attempt to compete against her projected victory.

oromo: Qorannoon dhiheenya kana bahe akka agarsiisutti, hogganaan garee mirga-dhihoo Faransaay Maariin Le Pen filannoo pirezidaantummaa bara 2027 dura hoggansa cimaa keessa jirti. Kanaan dura yakka maallaqaa irratti himatamtee turus, murteen mana murtii filannoo irratti hirmaachuuf carraa ishee deebiseera. Gamtaan, gareewwan bitaa-hoggantoonni Le Peniin mo'achuuf tokkummaa uumuu irratti rakkoo keessa jiru.

title: How the US sanctions on Iran impact China
english: The United States has imposed sanctions on specific Chinese groups connected to Iranian operations, though it has avoided targeting China's major financial institutions. Washington is actively pressuring Beijing to limit its oil imports from Iran to discourage ties with the country's shadow networks. Both nations are currently navigating these tensions in hopes of maintaining broader trade stability ahead of a planned summit between their leaders.

oromo: Ameerikaan gareewwan Chaayinaa kanneen hojii dhookataa Iraan wajjin hidhata qaban irratti qarqarsa kasteerti, ta’us baankiiwwan gurguddoo Chaayinaa tuquurraa of qusatteerti. Waashingitan, Chaayinaan gabaa Iraan irraa boba'aa galchitu akka hir'iftu fi harka Iraan wajjin qabdu akka laaffiftu dhiibbaa gochaa jirti. Mootummoonni lamaan fuulduraatti walga'ii gaggeessitoota isaanii irratti wal arguuf karoorfataniiru; kanaafuu, daldala isaanii eeggachuuf jecha rakkoo kana tasgabbeessuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: Ex-Wimbledon champion Vondrousova appeals to CAS over four-year doping ban
english: Former Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova has challenged a four-year suspension at the Court of Arbitration for Sport. The ban was imposed after she failed to provide a sample during an out-of-competition drug test attempt at her home last December. Vondrousova claims the request felt like an invasion of her privacy and maintains that she has never engaged in doping.

Vondruusoovaan gochi kun dhuunfaa ishee akka tuqu dubbachuun, matumaa qoricha dhorkaa akka hin fayyadamne mirkaneessiteetti.

title: India faces criticism from UN discrimination watchdog
english: The United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination has raised serious concerns regarding the treatment of marginalized groups in India. The panel highlighted systemic violence, including extrajudicial killings and torture by law enforcement, directed at Dalits, tribal communities, and Muslim minorities. The committee has urged the Indian government to investigate these human rights abuses and ensure that all citizens are protected from discriminatory violence.

title: Exam Reforms Aren’t Fixing Ethiopia’s Institutional Decay
english: Despite recent reforms to improve exam security and reduce cheating, the Ethiopian education system continues to face deep-rooted issues regarding integrity and character development. Schools often prioritize achieving high test scores over fostering ethical behavior, creating a 'hidden curriculum' that rewards shortcuts instead of genuine learning. These disappointing pass rates suggest that merely preventing exam fraud does not address the underlying systemic decay that undermines professional and public life.

title: China warns it will safeguard its interests after US widens sanctions against Iran
english: China has pledged to protect its national interests after the United States announced a significant expansion of economic sanctions against Iran and its international business partners. The U.S. Treasury Secretary stated that countries trading with Iran will face isolation, aiming to cut off the regime's revenue sources. Beijing condemned the move as illegal and warned that it would take necessary steps to defend its legitimate economic cooperation with Tehran.

title: Is AIPAC’s political standing declining in the US?
english: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC), once a dominant political force, is seeing its influence wane as candidates from both major US parties begin to distance themselves. For instance, Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers recently asked the group to avoid campaigning for him to prevent a political backlash, particularly in areas with large Arab American populations. This shift highlights a growing bipartisan concern that aligning with AIPAC’s unconditional support for Israel has become a political liability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እስራኤል የህዝብ ጉዳዮች ኮሚቴ (AIPAC) በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የፖለቲካ መድረክ ላይ ያለው ተፅዕኖ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱ እየታየ ነው። በቅርቡ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ሴኔት እጩ ማይክ ሮጀርስ በምርጫ ቅስቀሳው ላይ ተሳትፎ እንዳያደርጉ ቡድኑን በመጠየቃቸው፣ ድርጅቱ ለሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ወገኖች ሸክም እየሆነ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። ይህ አካሄድ አሜሪካውያን ለእስራኤል ያላትን ድጋፍ እንደገና በመመርመራቸው ምክንያት፣ ፖለቲከኞች ከቡድኑ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዲያላሉ እያደረጋቸው ነው።
oromo: Manni maree dhimma ummataa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el (AIPAC) dhiibbaa inni siyaasa Ameerikaa irratti qabu hir'achaa dhufuun hubatameera. Kanneen filannoo irratti dorgoman garee kana irraa fagaachuu kan jalqaban yoo ta'u, fakkeenyaaf, dorgomaan paarlaamaa Republican Maayik Roojars deeggarsa AIPAC akka hin barbaanne ibseera. Jijjiiramni kun kan agarsiisu, deeggarsa Israa'elif kennamu irratti yaaddoon uumamuun isaa siyaasa Ameerikaa keessatti gareen AIPAC akka ulfaataa itti ta'e dha.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's ongoing National Dialogue is facing severe criticism for its failure to include major political and armed groups, particularly those from Tigray. By excluding key stakeholders and failing to facilitate electoral representation for the region, the government risks repeating historical patterns that previously led to Eritrea's independence. Critics argue that this process lacks genuine legitimacy and threatens to further destabilize the country's unity.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር ሂደት ዋነኛ የፖለቲካ እና የትጥቅ ቡድኖችን በተለይም የትግራይ ተወካዮችን ባለማካተቱ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። መንግስት ቁልፍ ባለድርሻ አካላትን በማግለሉ እና በክልሉ የምርጫ ተሳትፎን ባለማረጋገጡ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ምክንያት የነበሩ ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች እየተደገሙ እንደሆነ ተሰግቷል። ይህ አካሄድ የምክክር ሂደቱን ተአማኒነት እንደሚያሳጣው እና የአገሪቱን አንድነት ለአደጋ እንደሚዳርግ ተቺዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Marii biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa amma adeemsifamaa jiru kun gareewwan siyaasaa fi hidhattoota guguddaa, keessattuu kanneen Tigraay irraa dhufan hirmaachisuu dhabuusaatiin qeeqama cimaa keessa jira. Mootummaan qaamolee murteessoo ta'an hirmaachisuu diduunsaa fi bakka bu'iinsa filannoo naannichaa mirkaneessuu dadhabuunsaa, seenaa kanaan dura Eritraan akka adda baatu sababa ta'e deebisee kakaasuuf akka deemu sodaatama. Qeeqtonni akka jedhanitti, adeemsi kun amanamummaa kan dhabee fi tokkummaa biyyattii balaaf kan saaxilu dha.

title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
english: A powerful tornado struck the French village of Pomas, injuring 39 people and causing significant damage to hundreds of homes and historic buildings. Emergency crews were dispatched to the scene, where residents described the destruction as overwhelming with roofs torn off and many structures reduced to rubble. Additionally, the extreme weather caused widespread power outages and forced the cancellation of a professional cycling race in the surrounding region.
amharic: ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በደቡብ ምዕራብ ፈረንሳይ በሚገኘው የፖማስ መንደር በመምታቱ 39 ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። አውሎ ንፋሱ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችንና ታሪካዊ ሕንጻዎችን ያፈረሰ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች ደግሞ ከኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ውጪ ሆነዋል። አደጋውን ተከትሎ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ሠራተኞች የነፍስ አድን ሥራ እያከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ይካሄድ የነበረው የብስክሌት ውድድርም በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት እንዲቋረጥ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Bubbee cimaan ganda Pomas kan jedhamu kibba-dhiha Faransaayitti argamu rukutee namoota 39 irratti miidhaa geessiseera. Bubbeen kun manneen dhibbaan lakkaa'aman fi ijaarsaalee seena-qabeessa ta'an mancaasuun, naannicha guutummaatti ibsaa irraa addaan baaseera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa iddoo sana ga'uun hojii gargaarsaafi qulqulleessaas gaggeessaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, qilleensa cimaa kanaan walqabatee dorgommiin baayikilii naannichatti gaggeeffamaa ture akka dhaabbatu ta'eera.

title: Kit Harington replaces Nicholas Hoult in HBO's Harry Potter series
english: Kit Harington has been cast as Gilderoy Lockhart in the upcoming HBO Harry Potter television series, replacing Nicholas Hoult who stepped down due to scheduling conflicts. Harington, famous for his role in Game of Thrones, has previously voiced the character and expressed great enthusiasm for joining the production. The second season of the show will adapt J.K. Rowling’s The Chamber of Secrets and features a star-studded cast including John Lithgow and Nick Frost.
amharic: ኪት ሀሪንግተን በ HBO የሃሪ ፖተር ተከታታይ የቴሌቪዥን ድራማ ላይ ጊልደሮይ ሎክሃርት የተሰኘውን ገፀ-ባህሪ ለመተወን ተመርጧል። ቀደም ሲል ለዚህ ሚና ተመርጦ የነበረው ኒኮላስ ሆልት በጊዜ ሰሌዳ አለመጣጣም ምክንያት ፕሮግራሙን ለቋል። ከጨዋታ ኦፍ ትሮንስ በሚታወቀው ኪት ሀሪንግተን አማካኝነት የሚሰራው ይህ ሁለተኛው የፊልም ክፍል፣ የጄ.ኬ. ሮውሊንግን ሁለተኛ መጽሐፍ ታሪክ የሚተርክ ይሆናል።
oromo: Kit Harington sagantaa televishenii HBO kan Harry Potter keessatti akka nama Gilderoy Lockhart taphatu filatameera; kunis kan ta'e Nicholas Hoult rakkoo yeroo qabachuun walqabatee erga gagga'ee booda dha. Taphatichi Game of Thrones keessatti beekamu kun, kanaan dura sagalee isaa kennee kan tureefi hojii kana keessatti hirmaachuun isaa baay'ee akka gammachiise ibseera. Kutaan lammaffaan sagantichaa kitaaba J.K. Rowling kan The Chamber of Secrets jedhamu kan hordofu ta'a.

title: Can Pakistan’s Asim Munir convince Iran military chiefs to return to talks?
english: Pakistan's military chief, Asim Munir, visited Tehran to mediate peace talks between Iran and the United States. While Iran's political leadership has shown interest in ending the ongoing conflict, the nation's military establishment remains hesitant and aggressive. Munir is now tasked with bridging this divide and persuading Iranian military officials to return to the negotiating table.
amharic: የፓኪስታን ወታደራዊ መሪ አሲም ሙኒር በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የሰላም ድርድር ለማደራደር ወደ ቴህራን ተጉዘዋል። የኢራን ፖለቲካዊ አመራር ግጭቱን ለመጨረስ ፍላጎት ቢያሳዩም፣ የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ አካላት ግን አሁንም ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። አሁን የሙኒር ዋና ፈተና ይህንን ልዩነት በማጥበብ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንዲመለሱ ማሳመን ነው።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Paakistaan Asim Muniir, marii nagaa gidduu Iraanii fi Ameerikaatti taasifamuuf gara Tehraan imaleera. Hoggantoonni siyaasaa Iraan waraana kana xumuruuf fedhii yoo qabaatanis, qaamoleen waraana biyyattii garuu ammayyuu shakkii qabu. Amma galmi ijoo Muniir, garaagarummaa kana hir'isuun hoggantoota waraana Iraan gara mariitti akka deebi'an amansiisuudha.

title: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour, giant of resistance art, dies aged 79
english: Renowned Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour has passed away at 79 following a long illness. Known for his iconic work depicting Palestinian heritage and resistance, he played a crucial role in building a visual identity for his people for over five decades. His creative use of natural materials and traditional symbols earned him international recognition and turned his art into a lasting archive of the Palestinian struggle.
amharic: ታዋቂው የፍልስጤም ሰዓሊ ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ። አርቲስቱ በፍልስጤም ባህልና የትግል ታሪክ ላይ ባተኮሩ ስራዎቻቸው የሚታወቁ ሲሆን፣ ለአምስት አስርት ዓመታት የፍልስጤም ህዝብ ማንነትን በመግለጽ ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ነበራቸው። በተፈጥሮ ቁሳቁሶችና ባህላዊ ምልክቶች በመጠቀም የፈጠሩት ጥበብ ዓለም አቀፍ አድናቆትን ያተረፈ ሲሆን፣ ለፍልስጤም ትግል ታሪክ እንደ ወሳኝ ማህደር ይታያል።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa Filisxeem Sliman Mansuur umuriisaa waggaa 79tti dhukkubaan du'an. Inni aartii aadaa fi qabsoo Filisxeem bakka bu'uun beekamuun, waggoota shantamii olaf eenyummaa saba isaa aartii kanaan mul'isaa ture. Meeshaalee uumamaa fi mallattoolee aadaa fayyadamuun hojiin inni hojjete sadarkaa addunyaatti fudhatama argatee jira; aartiin isaas seenaa qabsoo Filisxeem kan itti eegamu akka kuusaa seenaa guddaatti ilaalama.

title: Former Al Jazeera journalist Ali Younes arrested in Amman for allegedly sharing article questioning US aid to Jordan
english: Jordanian authorities have arrested investigative journalist Ali Younes for allegedly sharing an article that criticized U.S. financial aid to Jordan. Younes, a dual Jordanian-American citizen, is facing serious national security charges including sedition and hate speech. He is currently barred from leaving the country while authorities pursue these legal actions against him.
amharic: የዮርዳኖስ ባለስልጣናት ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ትችት የሰነዘረ ጽሁፍ በማጋራታቸው የምርመራ ጋዜጠኛ አሊ ዩነስን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የሁለትዮሽ ዜግነት ያላቸው ጋዜጠኛው አሁን ላይ ብሔራዊ ደህንነትን መጋፋት እና የጥላቻ ንግግርን ጨምሮ በከባድ ክሶች እየተከሰሱ ይገኛሉ። ባለስልጣናቱ በጋዜጠኛው ላይ የጉዞ እገዳ የጣሉ ሲሆን ክሱ እስኪጣራ ድረስ ከሀገር እንዳይወጡ ተከልክለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yordaanos gabaasa gargaarsa maallaqa Ameerikaa Yordaanositti kennamu mormu qoodate jechuun gaazexeessaa qorannoo Alii Yunees hidheera. Lammii Yordaanosii fi Ameerikaa kan ta'e gaazexeessichi, amma yakka nageenya biyyaa fi jibbiinsa babal'isuun himatamee jira. Aangoo goottonni kun guyyaa har'aa gaazexeessicha irratti dhorkaa daandii kan godhan yoo ta'u, himannaa irratti dhiyaate kana qulqulleessuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: China warns US against expanding Iran sanctions to Chinese firms
english: China has cautioned the United States that it will respond with countermeasures if the Trump administration implements new sanctions on Chinese businesses related to Iran. Beijing formally criticized these unilateral actions, arguing that they lack international legal support and hinder diplomatic efforts. While the U.S. Treasury Department has targeted specific firms in mainland China and Hong Kong, it has avoided imposing penalties on major financial institutions for now.
amharic: ቻይና አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ በቻይና ኩባንያዎች ላይ አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን የምትጥል ከሆነ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስጠንቅቃለች። ቤጂንግ እነዚህ የአሜሪካ የጎንዮሽ ማዕቀቦች ዓለም አቀፍ ህጋዊ መሰረት የሌላቸው እና የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶችን የሚያደናቅፉ ናቸው ስትል ተቃውሞዋን ገልጻለች። የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት በቻይና እና በሆንግ ኮንግ የሚገኙ አንዳንድ ኩባንያዎችን ቢቀጣም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን ዋና ዋና የቻይና የፋይናንስ ተቋማትን ከመቅጣት ተቆጥቧል።
oromo: Chaayinaan, mootummaan Traamp dhimma Iraaniin walqabatee dhaabbilee Chaayinaa irratti tarkaanfii sanasii haaraa yoo fudhate, isheenis deebii cimaa akka kennitu akeekkachiisteetti. Beejingin tarkaanfiiwwan gama tokkeen fudhataman kun bu’uura seeraa kan hin qabneefi carraaqqii nagaa kan gufachiisan ta’uu ibsiteetti. Ministeerri Maallaqa Amerikaa dhaabbilee Chaayinaa fi Hong Kong keessa jiran tokko tokko irratti sanasii kan kute ta’us, ammaaf dhaabbilee faayinaansii gurguddoo irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu irraa of qusateera.

title: Israeli politician filmed smashing Palestinian memorial in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli lawmaker Zvi Sukkot was recorded using a sledgehammer to dismantle a monument dedicated to Palestinians killed in the West Bank. The incident took place in the village of Madama while Israeli security forces observed the scene without intervening. This action follows the politician's recent public calls for the destruction of such memorials throughout the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፓርላማ አባል ዝቪ ሱኮት በምዕራብ ባንክ የተገደሉ ፍልስጤማውያን መታሰቢያ ሐውልትን በመዶሻ ሲያፈርስ የሚያሳይ ምስል ተሰራጭቷል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው በማዳማ መንደር ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ወታደሮችም በቦታው ተገኝተው ጣልቃ ሳይገቡ ተመልክተዋል። ፖለቲከኛው ከዚህ ቀደም መሰል መታሰቢያዎችን ለማፍረስ በአደባባይ ጥሪ አቅርቦ እንደነበር ይታወቃል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree Israa'el Zvi Sukkot, yaaddannoo namoota Falasxiin kanneen seeraan alaa qabamee jiru biyya West Bank keessatti ajjeefamaniif dhaabbate, qottoon yommuu diigu viidiyoon isaa gadhiifameera. Gochi kun kan raawwatame baadiyaa Madama jedhamutti yoo ta'u, loltoonni Israa'el iddoo sana turan illee tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhiisaniiru. Siyaasni kun kanaan dura yaaddannoo akkasii guutummaa naannichatti akka diigamu ibsee ture.

title: US promises 'asphyxiation' of Islamic Republic as it imposes new sanctions
english: The United States has announced severe new sanctions against Iran, aiming to completely cut off the nation's economy and force it into total isolation. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that the U.S. is aggressively targeting all networks involved in oil smuggling to stop the regime's activities. This strategy, which has sparked criticism from China for destabilizing the global economy, has already caused a significant decline in shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: What would justice look like if there were no Rohingya left in Myanmar?
english: Nine years after the 2017 genocidal campaign, the Rohingya people continue to face systemic violence and displacement in Myanmar. Although the Arakan Army has gained control of Rakhine state, the Rohingya remain targets of forced labor, killings, and ongoing persecution. International efforts for justice have so far failed to provide adequate protection or accountability for this marginalized group.

title: Roadblocks and burning tyres in Libya protests over power cuts
english: Residents in Tripoli, Libya, recently took to the streets to voice their anger over persistent electrical shortages and the failure of the power grid. Demonstrators blocked major roads and set tires on fire to protest these worsening conditions. This unrest highlights growing public frustration with the country's unreliable utility services.

title: Indonesia battles haze as wildfires rage across South Sumatra forests
english: Indonesia is currently struggling with severe wildfires in South Sumatra, which have caused dangerous levels of air pollution and forced citizens to gather for prayers seeking rain. The fires, worsened by a dry season and El Nino, have spread across hundreds of square kilometers and created a haze affecting neighboring countries like Malaysia and Brunei. To address the crisis, the government has deployed aircraft to combat the flames while also launching investigations and making arrests related to illegal land-clearing practices.

title: Kremlin adviser warns UK drone factories could face attacks
english: A Kremlin adviser has warned that drone manufacturing facilities in the UK could face potential attacks following Britain's decision to share missile blueprints with Ukraine. Moscow views this technology transfer as direct British military involvement in the ongoing conflict. While official Russian sources suggest these actions might involve cyberattacks or semi-military measures, the UK maintains that its support is a necessary response to Russia's invasion.

english: Thousands of nurses in Kenya have launched a strike to protest against inadequate wages and poor working conditions. title: Nvidia, Supermicro employees charged over export of AI servers to China
english: Taiwanese authorities have indicted nine individuals, including workers from Nvidia and Supermicro, for illegally smuggling advanced AI servers to China. Prosecutors are now seeking jail time for those involved, highlighting a need for stricter laws regarding the export of sensitive semiconductor technology.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's democratic progress is hindered by deep-seated social patterns that prioritize strict obedience over open dialogue. From childhood and family life to schools and workplaces, citizens are often taught that questioning authority is a sign of disloyalty. This ingrained culture of hierarchy discourages critical thinking and collective cooperation, making it difficult to build a truly participatory democratic society.

title: Pakistan says significant progress made in talks on Iran-US war
english: High-level Pakistani officials, including the army chief and interior minister, visited Tehran to mediate a resolution to the ongoing conflict between Iran and the US. During these discussions, both nations explored ways to de-escalate tensions, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and revive a previous peace framework known as the Islamabad MoU. While Iranian leadership emphasized that the US must change its coercive approach, Pakistani representatives reported that the talks were highly positive and productive.

title: Rohingya refugees protest, nine years after exodus to Bangladesh
english: Rohingya refugees living in Bangladesh recently held protests to mark the nine-year anniversary of their mass departure from Myanmar. The demonstrators gathered to demand justice and international recognition for the violence and alleged genocide they endured. They remain trapped in the world's largest refugee camp, continuing to seek accountability for the tragedy that forced them to flee their homes.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በሚገኙ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚኖሩ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች ከሚናማር የተሰደዱበት ዘጠነኛ ዓመት በማስመልከት የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ስደተኞቹ በደረሰባቸው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን እና አለም አቀፍ ትኩረት እንዲሰጣቸው ጠይቀዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለማችን ትልቁ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ የሚገኙት እነዚህ ሰዎች ለተፈናቀሉበት ግፍ ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር መጠየቃቸውን ቀጥለዋል።

title: Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic falls to lowest level since May
english: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped significantly on Monday, with only two commodity tankers passing through, marking the lowest daily count since May. This figure is a sharp decline from the typical average of 14 vessels recorded over the previous ten days. Shipping experts also reported a notable decrease in the total volume of daily oil flows passing through this critical maritime route.

title: Colombia lifts coal export ban on Israel imposed over Gaza genocide
english: The new Colombian administration has reversed a coal export ban to Israel that was originally implemented by the previous government to protest the conflict in Gaza. Government officials recently announced the authorization of these shipments, although specific details regarding the timeline or regulatory requirements remain undisclosed. This move marks a significant shift in policy compared to the previous administration, which had even severed diplomatic ties with Israel.

title: Global ocean temperatures hit record high as El Nino intensifies
english: Global sea surface temperatures have reached an all-time high, surpassing previous records set in 2024. Experts from the Copernicus Climate Change Service attribute this rise to a combination of long-term human-induced climate change and the strengthening El Nino weather phenomenon. This unusual warming, occurring well outside the typical peak season, poses severe threats to marine ecosystems, coastal communities, and global food security.

title: Thai vendor confronts Israeli tourists, raises Palestinian flag
english: A street vendor in Phuket, Thailand, was filmed confronting a group of Israeli tourists by waving a Palestinian flag and shouting pro-Palestinian slogans. The shopkeeper ordered the group to leave his premises after alleging that one of the tourists had previously provoked him by yelling in support of Israel. The incident highlights the localized impact of the ongoing Middle East conflict on public interactions abroad.
